title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. ramosifolium
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. ramosifolium, commonly known as lesser hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions of antimicrobial and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium vulgatum subsp. ramosifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. While further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness, traditional knowledge suggests that lesser hawkweed may have potential therapeutic uses.
